title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Escalation by the Conduct of the Term Just Ending
content:
## Collections schedule

The escalation applied to the price of a further term on a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record follows how the account behaved through the term just ending. The count is of the charges for instalments left unpaid standing on the agreement.

| Charges for instalments left unpaid standing on the agreement | Escalation applied |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | the arrears escalation, 6.0 percent |
| 1 or 2 | the standing escalation, 4.5 percent |
| none | the escalation the tier publishes |

### Schedule notes

- At a count of exactly 3 the arrears escalation of 6.0 percent applies; at a count of exactly 1 and at exactly 2 the standing escalation of 4.5 percent applies.
- Where no such charge stands on the agreement, the escalation is the one published for the agreement's own tier on the renewal terms table.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A base of 6 000.00 USD raised at 6.0 percent gives 6 360.00 USD; raised at 4.5 percent it gives 6 270.00 USD.
